_meta.description: Per-ayah verse-equivalence aliases across the three shipped riwayat. DERIVED MECHANICALLY from KFGQPC Madinah Mushaf word-stream alignment — KFGQPC IS the authoritative scholarly source for the splits encoded in this dataset. Identity-mapped (Hafs N → Warsh N → Qaloon N) surahs are NOT included; only surahs whose counts diverge across riwayat. Aliases use Hafs as the canonical key (matches translation packs). `null` value means no equivalent ayah in that riwayah; an array means the Hafs ayah maps to multiple ayat in that riwayah; a number means 1:1 alias.
_meta.method: Word-stream cumulative alignment. Hafs ayah I aligns to the contiguous Warsh / Qaloon ayat whose normalised-text word ranges overlap Hafs ayah I's range. Bismillah carve-out applied to surah 1. Hard-fails on qira'at-level word-count drift (no surahs in current dataset).
